Mapping decoded rows onto a caller column panel, and the element types

Maps a decoded row: for each element, col = map[id] ; elements whose
column is UNMAPPED are dropped, the rest are written in order to cols and vals . Values are dict[rank] for a dictionary ( dict holds its entries converted by Dict::cast_into ) or the raw values
read as S and converted. For mode-coded values, modes holds the
chunk’s column modes converted to T (see cast_values ), indexed by
coded id; it may be empty for chunks without column modes. cols and vals need room for every element of the row; map must cover the

row’s id order, so they are ascending only if the map is monotonic.
